name: Valmera
tagline: Edit existing footage by chat, review a rough cut and revise individual shots
description: Valmera is an AI video editor for footage you have already recorded. A creator can upload an interview, product demo or talking-head video, describe the cut, and review a preview before exporting an MP4. A follow-up request can shorten one shot while keeping the surrounding shots in order. The hosted editor runs in a browser. A remote MCP connector lets a compatible assistant work on the same project. AI editing requires a subscription. The public three-shot exercise includes the source recording and two exports for anyone to compare.
